The '''2013–14 Eredivisie''' was the 58th season of [[Eredivisie]] since its establishment in 1955. It began on 2 August 2013 with the first match of the season and ended on 18 May 2014 with the returns of the finals of the European competition and relegation playoffs.<ref>{{cite news |url=http://bin617-01.website-voetbal.nl/sites/voetbal.nl/files/Definitief%20programma%20betaald%20voetbal%20seizoen%201314%20dd%20280613.pdf |title=Programma betaald voetbal seizoen 2013/'14 Eredivisie / Jupiler League |date=28 June 2013 |access-date=29 June 2013 |publisher=KNVB |language=nl |archive-date=11 August 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130811004941/http://bin617-01.website-voetbal.nl/sites/voetbal.nl/files/Definitief%20programma%20betaald%20voetbal%20seizoen%201314%20dd%20280613.pdf |url-status=dead }}</ref>

== Teams ==
A total of 18 teams took part in the league: The best fifteen teams from the [[2012–13 Eredivisie|2012–13 season]], two promotion/relegation playoff winners and the [[2012–13 Eerste Divisie]] champions.

== European competition ==
The teams finishing fifth through eight play-off for a berth in the Second qualifying round of the [[2014–15 UEFA Europa League]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Eredivisie play - off voor Europees ticket 2013/'14|url=http://bin617-01.website-voetbal.nl/sites/voetbal.nl/files/Play%20offs%20europees%20ticket%201314%20stroomschema%20280414.pdf|publisher=KNVB|access-date=7 May 2014|archive-date=13 May 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140513150338/http://bin617-01.website-voetbal.nl/sites/voetbal.nl/files/Play%20offs%20europees%20ticket%201314%20stroomschema%20280414.pdf|url-status=dead}}</ref> [[FC Groningen|Groningen]] won this berth after winning the four-team play-off.

== Eredivisie play-offs ==
Ten teams played for two spots in the [[2014–15 Eredivisie]]. Four teams from the [[2013–14 Eerste Divisie]] entered in the first round, another four and the teams ranked 16th and 17th in the 2013–14 Eredivisie entered in the second round. Both winners of the third round, [[FC Dordrecht]] and [[S.B.V. Excelsior|Excelsior]], played in the 2014–15 Eredivisie.<ref>{{cite web|title=Jupiler Play - Offs seizoen 2013/'14|url=http://bin617-01.website-voetbal.nl/sites/voetbal.nl/files/POPD%20versie%20280414.pdf|publisher=KNVB|access-date=7 May 2014|archive-date=13 May 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140513134807/http://bin617-01.website-voetbal.nl/sites/voetbal.nl/files/POPD%20versie%20280414.pdf|url-status=dead}}</ref>
